title: Volcanoes of Ecuador (streak)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Ecuador, one after another. Three markers too far from the place end the run, so aim with care. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Sangay
rounds.fact: Sangay is a stratovolcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 2021. The data places it in Ecuador.
